heading: No one is dealing
body: A distribution has no hand behind it. Whatever order you find here, you brought.

heading: The field remembers nothing
body: Each round begins from zero. Only the player carries the account forward.

heading: Nothing is owed
body: A loss creates no claim on what comes next. Gỡ is the belief that it does.

heading: The middle is a habit
body: Not a property of the structure. Something we install to make it legible.

heading: Maintained, not governed
body: What holds this together is upkeep, not command.

heading: Every part answers another
body: That is the whole mechanism. There is no additional part that decides.

heading: To decentralise is not to dissolve
body: It is to redistribute: attention, authorship, labour, and the right to decide.

heading: The wish outlives the center
body: Remove the house and the search for a house continues.

heading: Empty is the usual state
body: Most numbers hold nothing. This is not the exception to the system, it is the system.

heading: A pattern is a thing you make
body: The sequence did not produce it. You did, and then you bet on it.

heading: Weight without a middle
body: Load can be carried by a field. It does not need a column.

heading: A slower order
body: What remains after the center is removed is not disorder. It is harder to own.

heading: Nothing accumulates
body: Attention accumulates. Probability does not.

heading: The next round is not the one
body: No round is the one. That is what makes the next one possible.

heading: One position short
body: Suýt is not a failure. It is a promise, and it is engineered to feel like one.

heading: Almost is manufactured
body: The near-miss has an author. The author is not where the player is looking.

heading: Labour is where the center hides
body: Ask who maintains it. That is usually the middle you were told did not exist.

heading: Credit without a single author
body: The hardest problem in working this way. Not a technical one.

heading: Disagreement is structure
body: A group that cannot hold it has a center, whatever it calls itself.

heading: Porous
body: The boundary is where the negotiation happens. Sealing it is a way of deciding alone.

heading: Who decides what a room is for
body: This question is the whole of it.

heading: The people who stay
body: When there is no house to appeal to, this is what is left. It is enough.

heading: Drift is not failure
body: It is the system telling you what it is, rather than what you set it to be.

heading: Kept rather than corrected
body: The deviation is the material. Correcting it is a preference for the plan.

heading: A round, not a step
body: Steps lead somewhere. Rounds return.

heading: No node holds command
body: Each one passes what it receives. Command is a description added afterwards.

heading: The house is also a node
body: It takes a fixed cut. It does not decide the outcome. Both are true.

heading: Read as a text
body: Two digits, and a street reads them as a message. Meaning is made downstream.

heading: Independent events
body: The word independent is doing all the work, and nobody believes it.

heading: Nothing arrives finished
body: Each state is a stake placed on the next.
